install.linux: pip install awscli || curl https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip -o awscliv2.zip && unzip awscliv2.zip && sudo ./aws/install

s3_get_object.guidance: Downloads to stdout. Use for text files only.

lambda_invoke.guidance: Payload should be a JSON string

sts_get_caller_identity.guidance: Verify which AWS account/role is active

notes: AWS CLI must be configured: run `aws configure` or set AWS_PROFILE. Most commands default to the region in AWS_DEFAULT_REGION.
